# What does an app subscriber really leave you?

> Free calculator for indie app developers: what a subscription charge really leaves after store fees, tax and refunds, what a subscriber is worth at your churn, how long payback takes, and what a web checkout would change. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/app-subscription-proceeds-calculator/)
- [What a 30 vs 15 percent store fee does to subscriber value, and when churn matters more](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/app-subscription-proceeds-calculator/app-store-30-vs-15-percent-subscription-value.html)
